component.name: HelloCard
component.script:
sub init() th = LumenTheme() m.th = th m.top.translation = [96, 300] m.greetedFor = ""
' Paired: the greeting, with a soft deep shadow like the clock. m.greetShadow = greetLabel(2) m.greet = greetLabel(0)
' Not paired: the QR card. m.card = m.top.createChild("Group") m.fill = m.card.createChild("Poster") m.fill.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/card_r28.9.png" m.fill.width = 456 m.fill.height = 212 m.fill.opacity = 0.82 stroke = m.card.createChild("Poster") stroke.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/pill_64_stroke.9.png" stroke.width = 456 stroke.height = 212 tile = m.card.createChild("Poster") tile.uri = "pkg:/images/ui/card_r28.9.png" tile.blendColor = th.white tile.translation = [20, 20] tile.width = 172 tile.height = 172 m.qr = m.card.createChild("Poster") m.qr.translation = [30, 30] m.qr.width = 152 m.qr.height = 152 m.title = m.card.createChild("Label") m.title.font = LumenFont("Fraunces-Title", 28) m.title.color = th.white m.title.translation = [212, 22] m.title.width = 232 m.title.height = 96 m.title.wrap = true m.title.maxLines = 2 m.how = m.card.createChild("Label") m.how.font = LumenFont("Manrope-SemiBold", 19) m.how.color = WithAlpha(th.white, 0.85) m.how.translation = [212, 116] m.how.width = 232 m.how.height = 90 m.how.wrap = true m.how.maxLines = 3 update() end sub
function greetLabel(offset as integer) as object l = m.top.createChild("Label") l.font = LumenFont("Fraunces-Italic", 34) l.translation = [offset, offset] l.width = 470 l.height = 100 l.wrap = true l.maxLines = 2 if offset > 0 then l.opacity = 0.75 else l.color = m.th.white return l end function
sub onDeep() m.fill.blendColor = m.top.deep m.greetShadow.color = m.top.deep end sub
sub update() if m.greet = invalid then return name = m.top.name known = (name <> invalid and name <> "") here = known and m.top.connected m.card.visible = not here m.greet.visible = here m.greetShadow.visible = here if known then m.title.text = "Reconnect, " + name else m.title.text = "Connect your phone" if here ' A new line only when the phone (re)connects, not on every repaint. if m.greetedFor <> name g = greeting(name) m.greet.text = g m.greetShadow.text = g m.greetedFor = name end if else m.greetedFor = "" m.qr.uri = pairQr() m.how.text = "In the Lumen phone app, tap Scan QR on the TV" end if end sub
' The QR image comes from a public QR service; all it carries is this TV's local address and name. function pairQr() as string di = CreateObject("roDeviceInfo") ip = "" addrs = di.GetIPAddrs() for each k in addrs ip = addrs[k] end for if ip = "" then return "" data = "lumen://connect?ip=" + ip + "&name=" + urlEscape(di.GetFriendlyName()) return "https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=304x304&margin=8&format=png&data=" + urlEscape(data) end function
' Percent-encoding by hand: roUrlTransfer (which has Escape) isn't allowed on the render thread. function urlEscape(s as string) as string ba = CreateObject("roByteArray") ba.FromAsciiString(s) out = "" for each b in ba if (b >= 48 and b <= 57) or (b >= 65 and b <= 90) or (b >= 97 and b <= 122) or b = 45 or b = 46 or b = 95 or b = 126 out = out + Chr(b) else h = UCase(StrI(b, 16)) if Len(h) = 1 then h = "0" + h out = out + "%" + h end if end for return out end function
' Picked fresh every launch; the time of day decides the pool. function greeting(name as string) as string now = CreateObject("roDateTime") now.ToLocalTime() h = now.GetHours() if h >= 5 and h < 12 pool = ["Morning, {n}. The sunflowers were up before you.", "Good morning, {n}. Coffee first, then the world.", "Rise and shine, {n}. Vincent painted at this hour too."] else if h >= 12 and h < 17 pool = ["Afternoon, {n}. Perfect light for doing nothing.", "Hey {n}, the day's half done. Treat yourself.", "Good afternoon, {n}. The irises say hi."] else if h >= 17 and h < 22 pool = ["Evening, {n}. The stars clocked in early for you.", "Welcome back, {n}. Couch mode: activated.", "Good evening, {n}. Something good on tonight?"] else pool = ["Still up, {n}? The stars are keeping you company.", "Late night, {n}. One more episode, then bed.", "Hello, night owl {n}. The sky's all yours."] end if return pool[Rnd(pool.Count()) - 1].Replace("{n}", name) end function
